title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 1st Proof Morality And Miracles

questions.question: What did the traveler tell his own mind to do first while searching for his Creator through creation?
questions.answer: He said he should first go to the most honored and greatest human being among creation, Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

questions.question: Why did the traveler choose to begin with Prophet Muhammad ﷺ?
questions.answer: Because he saw him as the most famous, most excellent, strongest leader, and most brilliant in understanding among people.

questions.question: How long does the passage say the Prophet’s excellence and Qur’an have given light to people?
questions.answer: For fourteen centuries.

questions.question: What did the traveler do in his mind so he could learn from the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.answer: He imagined himself entering the blessed time when the Prophet ﷺ lived.

questions.question: How did the traveler view the Prophet’s time?
questions.answer: He saw it as a time of true happiness and blessing.

questions.question: What change did the Prophet ﷺ bring to a people who had been uneducated and uncivilized?
questions.answer: He raised them until they became leaders and teachers of the world.

questions.question: Before asking about the Creator, what two things did the traveler want to learn about the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.answer: He wanted to know his true worth and whether his words and warnings were completely truthful.

questions.question: About how many main proofs did the traveler find and plan to mention briefly?
questions.answer: Nine.

questions.question: According to the first proof, what kind of character did the Prophet ﷺ have?
questions.answer: He had excellent manners and noble qualities.

questions.question: Whose witness is mentioned to show that the Prophet ﷺ had outstanding character?
questions.answer: Even his enemies admitted it.

questions.question: What is one miracle mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: The moon was split by Allah through the Prophet’s sign.

questions.question: What happened when the Prophet ﷺ threw dust toward his enemies?
questions.answer: It went into their eyes and caused them to run away.

questions.question: How was water given to the thirsty army in one of the miracles?
questions.answer: Water flowed from the Prophet’s fingers for them to drink.

questions.question: Does the passage describe only a few miracles or many miracles for the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.answer: It describes many miracles, more than three hundred.

questions.question: Why does the traveler conclude that the Prophet ﷺ could not be a liar or deceiver?
questions.answer: Because a person with such noble character and so many clear miracles must be the most truthful of people.

questions.question: When the traveler searched for his Master through the universe, whom did he decide to visit first?
questions.answer: He decided to turn first to Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.

questions.question: What made the Prophet ﷺ stand out above other creatures in the traveler’s view?
questions.answer: He was seen as the most famous, most complete, most respected in speech, and most shining in intellect.

questions.question: What does the passage say the Prophet ﷺ used to brighten many centuries?
questions.answer: His own excellence and the Qur’an.

questions.question: What happened to the early people who followed him?
questions.answer: They changed from a rough and unlearned people into guides and teachers for others.

questions.question: Why did the traveler first want to study the Prophet’s truthfulness before asking him about the Creator?
questions.answer: Because he wanted to be sure the Prophet’s message and warnings were fully reliable.

questions.question: How many broad proofs does the passage say will be mentioned briefly?
questions.answer: Nine broad proofs.

questions.question: In the first proof, what is said about the Prophet’s good qualities?
questions.answer: All kinds of fine character and beautiful traits were found in him.

questions.question: What does it mean that even enemies testified to his qualities?
questions.answer: It means his goodness was so clear that even those against him could not deny it.

questions.question: Name one miracle related to the sky that is mentioned.
questions.answer: The splitting of the moon.

questions.question: Name one miracle connected to battle that is mentioned.
questions.answer: Dust thrown by him reached the enemy’s eyes and made them retreat.

questions.question: Name one miracle connected to water that is mentioned.
questions.answer: Water came out from his fingers and satisfied the army’s thirst.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the number of his miracles?
questions.answer: It says there were more than three hundred.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention Qur’anic verses and widely reported narrations with the miracles?
questions.answer: To show that the miracles are supported by strong and trustworthy evidence.

questions.question: What kind of actions are called low and shameful at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: Cheating, lying, and making mistakes on purpose.

questions.question: What final judgment does the traveler make about the Prophet’s speech?
